recipes.name: Chipotle Chicken Thighs
instructions: Chop the chicken thighs into even, bite-sized pieces. Season with 1% salt by weight, then add the chipotles in adobo (mince into a paste if chunky), cumin, and garlic powder. Mix to evenly distribute the seasoning.

Preheat a pan over medium-high heat. Coat the cooking surface in a thin layer of neutral cooking oil, then add all the seasoned chicken to sear and begin cooking through. Occasionally stir & scrape the chicken off the bottom of the pan. Expect some water content to release from the chicken and mix with the seasoning to form a sauce. If it’s too watery or loose, increase the heat to reduce excess moisture. If the pan is too dry, add a splash of water to deglaze any stuck bits and prevent burning. When the chicken is cooked and the seasoning clings to each piece, remove it from the heat.
Enjoy right away, or portion and store the chicken in an airtight container in the fridge until ready to use.
